name: Fake a Brainrot
desc:
Transform into a brainrot to trick players and steal their brainrots! 😈

But be careful when you pick a brainrot, it could be someone else... 🥶

💥 Sneak into bases and steal brainrots before they catch you!
🏆 Inspect brainrots to figure out if they're fake or real!
⚡ Collect every rarity and mutation, from Common to Rainbow!
